candidates.title: From viral fame to violent deaths: 3 Punjab influencers murdered in 16 months
candidates.excerpt: Three social media creators in Punjab were murdered under different circumstances in a span of 16 months. Mad Sandhu was shot dead, Kanchan Kumari was found strangled, and Manjeet Kaur succumbed to severe burn injuries. Investigations into their deaths did not establish clear motives linking their online content to these killings. The incidents have sparked discussions about the safety of public figures and threats they face.

candidates.title: ‘Where did you sell gold chains?’ New videos give big twist to Sharma murder case
candidates.excerpt: After Shraddha Dubey's confrontational videos with Shiva Sharma went viral, new footage emerged showing her demanding the return of jewelry she claims was stolen. The situation escalated following Shiva's fatal fall from an apartment building on October 9, prompting police to search for Shraddha and her associates while offering rewards for information. Investigators have yet to verify the authenticity of the videos or the surrounding events.
